question: At which probability-processing stage does the sealed v2 very-heavy 2023-selected display cutoff stop issuing warnings on 2024 forecast arrays?
population: All 156 sealed 2024 national research forecast cases and every 5105 forecast-supported land cell per case; no 2024 IMD validity mask or rainfall value is read in this diagnostic.
cutoff_rule: Use only the already sealed 2023 calibrated/coherent out-of-fold cutoff stored in v2 models.json; do not refit, retune or select a new cutoff.
comparison_role: 2024 is already consumed development evidence. This forecast-only diagnostic explains a prior failure; it cannot establish reliability, skill or a new warning threshold.
